requests.prompt:
Exactly 6 isolated icons. Columns, left to right: (1) ALERT: a rounded yellow warning triangle with a thick dark navy exclamation mark '!' in it. (2) QUESTION: a round sky blue badge with a thick white question mark '?' in it. (3) SLEEP: two pale sky blue 3D letters 'Z', a small one at lower left overlapping a larger one at upper right, touching each other. (4) CHECK: a round fresh green badge with a thick white tick mark. (5) HEART: a plump glossy coral red heart. (6) COFFEE: a white ceramic coffee mug with a coral red band, brown coffee visible on top, and two short soft steam wisps right above it.

LAYOUT: exactly 6 icons in ONE horizontal row, each centred in its own equal-width column, all drawn at the SAME visual size (each icon about 170 px tall, fitting a square), separated by WIDE empty gaps of background (at least 90 px), none touching or overlapping, nothing else in the image. Each icon is ONE compact object (small parts like drops or letters stay very close to the main shape).

STYLE: a set of small soft glossy 3D game status icons for a cozy modern office management game (the game itself is a soft stylized 3D diorama with light oak, cream, sage green and dusty blue): chunky, simple, rounded, toy-like silhouettes that stay readable when shrunk to 16 pixels, smooth soft shading with a gentle specular highlight from the upper left, subtle bevels, slightly glossy plastic / enamel material. Consistent warm palette across the whole set: sunny yellow #FFCF3F, warm coral red #E85A5A, fresh green #45B866, sky blue #4F8FE6, cream white #F6F2EA, oak brown #C48A52, slate grey #8D97AB. Every icon has a thin dark navy outline (#2A3142) around its whole silhouette. Front view, facing the camera flat, no perspective tilt, no ground, no shadow. NOT pixel art, NOT flat vector, NOT photorealistic. Original design, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no extra text.

BACKGROUND: the entire background is one perfectly flat solid pure magenta color #FF00FF, edge to edge, no gradient, no texture, no shadow, no vignette, no frame. Every icon is fully visible with generous empty margin and is never cropped. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere on the icons (a music note is dusty blue-violet only if needed: prefer sky blue).
